brief: The world grapples with Russia's massive attack on Kyiv, Australian outrage over Israel's decision on aid worker death, and Prince Harry and Meghan's return to the UK, while research focuses on visual analytics evaluation and sonification of uncertainty.
news_summary: Russia's massive missile attack on Kyiv kills at least 13, prompting Ukraine to call for more air defenses. Australia expresses outrage as Israel declines to investigate the killing of aid worker Zomi Frankcom, and Prince Harry and Meghan plan to move back to Britain.
papers_summary: New papers explore model literacy as a summative evaluation factor for visual analytics and the affective aspects of sonification in uncertainty visualization, while another proposes a multimodal RAG to reduce technician search burden for aircraft maintenance.
